Notes: someone or something distant from both speaker and listener, or situation unfamiliar to both speaker and listener
Pronounced as よい in formal situations
In duolingo, it has a meaning of “dont really like”, for example このぼうしはちょっと → I don’t really like this hat (aka This hat is a little…)

Kana: ありがとうございます
Notes: ございます is the polite form of ござる
